titulo: Walgreens Boots Alliance, Sep 2023: about 258 years of median employee pay. The math, done.
caption:
Walgreens Boots Alliance, Sep 2023: about 258 years of median employee pay. The math, done.

On September 1, 2023 Walgreens announced that its CEO would step down effective August 31, 2023, with a separation agreement that includes $9 million in cash severance; its fiscal 2023 proxy reports the median employee's compensation.

From the archive: Sep 2023. Not today's news.

The math: $9,000,000 (cash severance in the CEO's separation agreement, fiscal 2023) ÷ $34,763 (median employee's compensation, fiscal 2023) = about 258 years of median employee pay. We round down.
The amount is the cash severance in the separation agreement. The 8-K lists other items. We do not count them. It is the amount agreed in the separation agreement, not what has been paid. The median pay is from the proxy statement for fiscal 2023, the same year.

(Our take.) Stepped down. Here is the exit column.

Sources
F1: Walgreens Boots Alliance Form 8-K, Item 5.02 (CEO separation), filed Sep 1, 2023 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1618921/000119312523226884/d497068d8k.htm
F2: Walgreens Boots Alliance proxy statement (DEF 14A), 2023 pay ratio, filed Dec 8, 2023 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1618921/000130817923001069/wba4243631-def14a.htm

The quotes on screen are copied from the filings. Original music. No narration.
